description: Cross-checks a target's live 402 body against its /.well-known/x402.json manifest (payTo/asset/network mismatches). Requires payment (0.01 USDC on Base, x402) -- NOT callable for free over MCP. Calling this tool returns the exact HTTP request to make instead; it does not run the check itself. See GET /deep-lint?url=... on this same origin.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the paid endpoint to check (should return HTTP 402).

name: deep_lint_x402_endpoint
